handoff.purpose: Define constants and utility functions for Ollama native API chat client.

symbols.name: num_ctx_value
symbols.note: Returns context window size, clamped to >=2048, with env override.

symbols.name: effective_input_window
symbols.note: Returns usable input tokens = num_ctx minus output_reserve.

symbols.name: _adapt_message
symbols.note: Converts native /api/chat assistant message to OpenAI shape.

symbols.name: _native_messages
symbols.note: Converts OpenAI-shaped assistant messages back to native form (incomplete in this chunk).

claims.text: The native /api/chat endpoint honors options.num_ctx, format:"json" and keep_alive -- the three fields the shim silently drops.
claims.why: No code in this chunk tests endpoint behavior; claim refers to external API behavior.

claims.text: DEFAULT_NUM_CTX = 6144 is sized by measurement, not by model's 32k max.
claims.why: Constant is defined as 6144; comment explains it's measured.

claims.text: Ollama OOM-kills the runner when it doesn't fit.
claims.why: Claim about runtime behavior not verifiable from code.

claims.text: An unset or non-integer env value falls back to the default -- this never raises.
claims.why: If raw is None or int() fails, returns DEFAULT_NUM_CTX; no raise.

claims.text: effective_input_window() returns usable input tokens = the full requested context minus generation reserve.
Ollama HEAD-truncates an over-long prompt, eating the SYSTEM prompt first.
claims.why: Claim about Ollama server behavior; not verifiable from code.

claims.text: Callers must fail loud against this reserved input budget rather than let the server truncate.
claims.why: No enforcement code in this chunk; refers to caller behavior.

claims.text: Native tool_calls arrive as {"function": {"name", "arguments": <dict>}} with NO id.
claims.why: Claim about native API response shape; not verifiable from code.

claims.text: The OpenAI loop expects arguments to be a JSON STRING and a stable id per call.
claims.why: Claim about external consumer (OpenAI loop); not verifiable from code.

claims.text: We re-serialize arguments with json.dumps and synthesize call_N ids.
claims.why: Code does json.dumps(args) and id: f'call_{i}'.

claims.text: The tool_calls key is OMITTED entirely when the native response has none, so callers can do msg.get("tool_calls") or [].
claims.why: Code only adds tool_calls key if native_calls is truthy; otherwise out has no tool_calls key.

claims.text: _native_messages converts any OpenAI-shaped assistant tool_calls back to native form for re-POSTing.
claims.why: Function body incomplete in this chunk; cannot verify conversion logic.

claims.text: Native /api/chat unmarshals arguments into an object and 400s on a string.
claims.why: Claim about external API behavior; not verifiable from code.

observations.what: Module docstring explains rationale for separate Ollama native client vs OpenAI compat shim.
DEFAULT_NUM_CTX and OUTPUT_RESERVE_TOKENS are hardcoded constants with measurement-based comments.
num_ctx_value() provides safe default with env override and clamp.
effective_input_window() computes usable input tokens; its docstring includes claims about Ollama truncation behavior not verifiable here.
_adapt_message handles tool_calls adaptation with id synthesis and JSON string conversion.
_native_messages function is incomplete in this chunk; only the loop start and docstring are present.
